hypothesis: Query-local empty-node mean fill is discontinuous. Normalizing cubic weights over occupied nodes should remove valid-region discontinuities; motion improvement is unknown.
construction: I(x)=sum(B_i(x)*occupied_i*node_mean_i)/sum(B_i(x)*occupied_i). Occupancy and node means are fixed at build time. Quotient-rule gradient includes the denominator derivative and inverse knot. This is a rational field, not an unchanged cubic B-spline or paper-specified sparse completion.
coverage: Retain the original at-least-four observed control count. Additionally require strictly positive occupied basis weight and finite value/gradient; otherwise no residual. No epsilon, extrapolation, new spatial/intensity scale, or per-sequence decision. Discrete count coverage boundaries remain; continuity claimed only for both-valid limits with positive denominator.

At zero-weight faces record removable one-sided limits separately; the originally declared continuity domain requires positive limit denominator.
